evals.name: edit-file-not-read-yet-auto-reread-no-user-prompt
evals.prompt: Edit 하려는데 'File has not been read yet' 에러가 났어. 어떻게 해야 해?
evals.expected_output: 사용자에게 재시도 여부 묻지 않고 즉시 Read 호출 후 동일 Edit 재시도. edit-read-guard hook block 이면 자동 복구 패턴 적용.

assertions.text: Response prescribes immediately calling Read on the file, then re-issuing the Edit — no user prompt between per §Edit / Write — 'File has not been read yet'
Response explicitly forbids asking the user '재시도할까요?' or '다시 읽고 진행할까요?' — the forbidden anti-pattern per §Forbidden anti-pattern
Response references the read-tracker invalidator events (user message, /compact, agent return, formatter run, etc.) that cause this failure per §Pre-emptive Read protocol
Response describes the edit-read-guard hook auto-recovery: block → immediate Read (offset=1, limit=5) → retry same Edit — 100% success guaranteed per §edit-read-guard block 시 무중단 자동 복구
Response specifies that if the auto-retry also fails, append Q-TOOL-<FILE> entry to docs/harness/user-queue.md and continue to next task per §Queue-on-double-failure
